findings.evidence: previous-version digest at dbff837f: 'removed units (135, showing 40)'. All 40 listed units resolve, through sections.json, to valid record.md rows (s001-s036). The other 95 units could not be checked one by one.
findings.fix: Regenerate the digest without a cut (or with a higher limit) so every removed unit can be checked against docs/audit/recovery/openapi-to-typescript/record.md. Add a row for any unit that has none.

findings.evidence: 'FastAPI 0.99.0 and later emit `openapi: 3.1.0` by default (its release notes: "Upgrade OpenAPI 3.1.0, this uses JSON Schema 2020-12")'. This is a vendor version fact with no source URL and no checked date. The springdoc gotcha right after it gives both.
findings.fix: Add the source and date inline, as in the springdoc line: '... (its release notes: "Upgrade OpenAPI 3.1.0, this uses JSON Schema 2020-12"; https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes/, checked <date>)'. The URL is the one already registered in docs/audit/upstream-sources.json.
